changelog: **Native messaging in the mobile app** (#2775). New `GET /api/conversations`: the caller's inbox (thread name, latest message, unread count, support unread, co-members to DM) as JSON. The query moved out of the `/messages` page into `src/lib/inbox.ts` (`loadInbox`), which the page and the endpoint now share, so the app and the web list the same rows the same way. The app gets a native inbox (pinned support line, unread badges, pull to refresh) and a native thread: reads `GET /api/messages?conversationId=` (which marks it read, as on the web), sends with a JSON `POST /api/messages`, polls every 5 s while open and in the foreground, honours `canPost`, shows deleted/edited messages and sender names in group rooms; attachments open in the signed-in web view. The Messages tab badge and the Notifications badge now come from one `GET /api/messages/unread`. Pinned by `e2e/mobile-messaging-api.spec.ts` (inbox → send → unread → open clears it, through the app's own no-Origin sign-in flow). Also fixes switching products: "Switch product" no longer signs out of the product being left — each host keeps its own session in the cookie jar, and picking a product reuses its live session or remembered device instead of asking for a password again.
